title: DomainRAG: A Chinese Benchmark for Evaluating Domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the factual accuracy (termed 'faithfulness') of RAG models against a domain-specific corpus related to university enrollment. Although 'faithfulness' and 'ethics' are mentioned as terms, they refer to technical adherence to source documents and noise handling rather than evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
